@WasmExport
fun WasmEntry() { WasmEntryInitialize() }

fun main() {
    val value = Random.nextInt()
    WasmRouter.register("init") {
        // 只要这里不访问_init 就能生成cwasm，访问_init 就会提示Error: Compilation error: Code for function is too large 访问_init 就会wasm文件就会从30kb飙升到700kb已经无解了吗
        init__
        "asdasd $value  "
    }
}
